name: D7s stress set (EXPLORATORY: gate R*=10 was chosen after looking at the data)
why: baseline violation rate is low (2 oracle violations in 48 u9b TRAIN fitx episodes); 24 tasks x 2 trials cannot show an effect
trials: 6 per task as 6 one-episode units with tau2 --seed 1..6 (user T=0.7, greedy agent); the same seed in both conditions = paired

conditions.d7obs: gate R*=10 (artifacts/d7_rewrite_r10_exploratory.json) scored on every turn, telemetry only, no intervention
conditions.d7c10: gate R*=10; on a write turn whose gate fires, the turn is discarded, '[system note] ' + the D7c note is appended as a user turn (template fallback) and the turn is regenerated greedily; no steering

primary: oracle violations per episode (reserve/qual/oracle.py), paired difference d7c10 - d7obs by (task, seed)
secondary: gate fires and whether the original action was a violation (precision/recall from d7obs)
success: d7c10 violations reduced by >= 50% vs d7obs AND reward drop <= 5 pp (exploratory)
outputs: new condition names d7obs_s1..s6, d7c10_s1..s6 under data/simulations/pilot/airline/; nothing existing is overwritten
